21. MULTIMEDIA TRAINING 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
One month multimedia training is given  to Locomotor 
and Hearing Impaired persons at National Institute of 
Film Development Corporation, Regional centre at 
Chennai.   
 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria   
The Locomotor Differently  Abled  persons   and 
hearing   impaired  persons    who have passed 8th 
standard. 
3. 
Whether form of application is 
prescribed. 
Yes. Applications are available with concerned 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
National Identity Card for Differently Abled and  
8th pass Certificate. 
5. 
Officer to whom the 
application is to be submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer. 
 
6. 
 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to  
Assistant Director (Placement), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the  
Differently Abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar Salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
